DR PARAG C. PARADKAR

DR PARADKAR is an internationally trained orthopaedic Surgeon & pain management specialist. DR PARADKAR has 15 years of experience treating more than 25000+ patients in India, Oman & Canada. DR PARADKAR completed his MBBS in 2005 followed by Diplomate Post graduate studies in orthopaedics in 2011. DR PARADKAR pursued his fellowship in Knee Arthroscopy under renowned joint replacement surgeon Dr. Hemant Wakankar also in 2011. Later, DR PARAG received advanced training in orthopaedic pain management through one year fellowship in Pain management at the prestigious TPC, Toronto, Canada. Over the last 15 years, DR PARADKAR gained extensive global patient care experience by practicing in India, OMAN & CANADA. Having returned to India, DR PARADKAR has established two clinics in July 2025 with the aim of delivering advanced international practised patient-centric orthopaedic pain management, with a focus on Non-Surgical (without Surgery). DR. PARADKAR specializes in Advanced Non-surgical, Minimally Invasive treatment for Neck Pain.

Specialization:

DR. PARADKAR specializes in Advanced Non-surgical, Minimally Invasive treatment for

  • Neck Pain
  • Back Pain
  • Knee Pain (Osteoarthritis)
  • Hip Pain
  • Ankle Pain
  • Heel Pain (Plantar Fasciitis)
  • Elbow Pain (Tennis Elbow, Golfer’s Elbow)
  • Wrist Pain (Carpal Tunnel Syndrome, De Quervain’s Disease)
  • Trigger Finger
  • Fibromyalgia
